lines: Even if the pale blue wind now knocks on the door of my chest
Enthralled by seeking what gently touches
Even fate is still unknown to those innocent eyes
But someday you'll notice, on that back
There are wings aimed at a distant future
It will soon take flight from the windowsill
My love's cradle has been sleeping forever
Only you will be called the messenger of dreams when morning comes
Moonlight reflects on your slender neck
I want to stop time across the world and lock it away, but
If the meaning lies in the two of us meeting
I am, then, the bible for learning freedom
The shape of the life I embraced
When I awaken from that dream
People weave love while forging history
I will live still unable to become a goddess
It will soon take flight from the windowsill
